Shri PL Tapdiya Takes Over as the President of Kasturba Health Society
Tuesday, 14 May 2024
3892 Hits
Shri PL Tapdiya has officially assumed the presidency of the esteemed Kasturba Health Society, marking a major milestone in the institution's illustrious history. Following the passing of Shri Dhirubhai Mehta in April 2024, Shri Tapdiya emerges as the third President of the society, stepping into the role with a wealth of experience and a deep commitment to the organization's mission.
With a distinguished background in chartered accountancy, Shri Tapdiya has been associated with Kasturba Health Society and MGIMS, the premier medical college, since its inception. His commitment to the institution's growth and development has been steadfast over the years. He has played major roles, serving as a financial consultant, member trustee, Vice-President, and now the President of Kasturba Health Society.
Dr. Sushila Nayar, the visionary founder of Kasturba Health Society, recognized Shri Tapdiya’s exceptional financial acumen early on when MGIMS was about to be born. She entrusted him with critical responsibilities that contributed to the establishment and expansion of the institution. His profound understanding of the organization and commitment to its principles have solidified his reputation as a trusted leader.
“Tapdiyaji is not just a colleague but a trusted companion on the journey of nearly four decades. I have worked closely with him, and I can attest to his extraordinary qualities. He must reciprocate our compliments by striving relentlessly to satisfy the institute’s needs.”, wrote Shri Dhirubhai Mehta in the book ‘By Iron Will’.
Shri Tapdiya’s leadership journey symbolizes dedication, commitment, and hard work; transcending from humble beginnings to leading one of the country’s premier institutions. Defined by a strong dedication to excellence, innovation, and the institute’s growth, Shri Tapdiya's tenure as President marks the beginning of a new era for the Kasturba Health Society.
Shri Tapdiya brings a new purpose and vision to MGIMS. He pledges to build on past achievements and guide the institute toward greater success. His leadership promises a future of growth, ensuring MGIMS remains a beacon of hope and healing for generations to come. This event heralds a new beginning for a medical college that has stood the test of time, offering affordable and appropriate medical education and healthcare.
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
